title: privacy: Maintainer's home path + username hardcoded in SHIPPING source: simemu/device.py:300 sets _PYMOBILEDEVICE…
description:
[P1 · privacy · audit] Maintainer's home path + username hardcoded in SHIPPING source: simemu/device.py:300 sets _PYMOBILEDEVICE3_PYTHON = "/Users/luke/.local/pipx/venvs/pymobiledevice3/bin/python". It is used as the python interpreter for the iOS 17+/iOS 26 real-device screenshot path (device.py:367) and printed in the remediation message (device.py:392). On any community member's machine this path does not exist and there is no shutil.which/env fallback, so the tunneld screenshot path is BROKEN — and it leaks the username 'luke'.

Evidence: simemu/device.py:300 `_PYMOBILEDEVICE3_PYTHON = ("/Users/luke/.local/pipx/venvs/pymobiledevice3/bin/python")`; used at device.py:367 and :392

Fix: Resolve the interpreter dynamically: `shutil.which('pymobiledevice3')` or `os.environ.get('SIMEMU_PMD3_PYTHON', sys.executable)`; never hardcode an absolute /Users/<name> path.

Source: launch-readiness audit 2026-06-18
